Title: [LSJ] Secure Haven and Directed actions turned indirected

Messages.Author: Smiling Tom
Messages.Body:
As far as I know, you can perform direct actions on your own vamps, as long
as they fit the rules. Thus, this actions are treated as undirected actions.

The question is: If I put a Secure Heaven on, say, Angra Mainyu, is it
possible for me to play a temptation/derange on that vamp?

Thanks in advance

Smiling Tom

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Smiling Tom wrote:
> As far as I know, you can perform direct actions on your own vamps, as long
> as they fit the rules. Thus, this actions are treated as undirected actions.

They *are* undriected actions, yes.

>
> The question is: If I put a Secure Heaven on, say, Angra Mainyu, is it
> possible for me to play a temptation/derange on that vamp?

Yes.
